subject: Post-demo recap & procurement next steps (AcmeCloud)
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & procurement next steps (AcmeCloud)

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for your time today; great to walk through how Redwood can reduce token cost and latency for your search assistant. Quick recap and suggested next steps:

- Demo notes: agreed target latency 150-60ms P95 for short prompts, and wanting live-chat style streaming for agents.
- Security: you mentioned a short security questionnaire from your IS team (SOC2 + logging/audit). Marcus will take point.
- Procurement path: you said finance prefers PO for platform contracts but sometimes uses corporate card for pilots.
- Marketplace: you asked whether an AWS Marketplace listing is an option for faster procurement. We can support both.

Suggested next steps (mutual action plan attached):
1) I'll send over a mutual action plan with milestones (legal review -> security questionnaire -> finance/PO -> onboarding).
2) Marcus to send our SOC2 and brief runbook for security review.
3) Marissa to share pricing options for pilot (card) vs committed Dedicated (PO).

Can you confirm who from AcmeCloud will own legal/fin/IS reviews and whether you prefer PO vs card for an initial pilot?

Thanks,

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_acmecloud.xlsx

From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecloud.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Cc: Bob Turner <bob.turner@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & procurement next steps (AcmeCloud)

Thanks Rachel — really helpful recap.

Internal owners:
- Legal: Sarah Kim (legal@acmecloud.com)
- InfoSec: Bob Turner (bob.turner@acmecloud.com) he'll do the security questionnaire
- Finance: Priya Shah (finance@acmecloud.com) will own PO issuance

Procurement path: finance prefers a PO for any contract over $25k/yr; for a short 30-day pilot we can use corporate card to speed things up. If you can provide a marketplace option (AWS Marketplace), that will likely speed procurement and avoid contract redlines.

Bob, I'm looping you on the security ask. Can you confirm expected SLA/controls and whether you need any additional artifacts?

Best,
Alice
Senior PM, Search
AcmeCloud

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
To: Bob Turner <bob.turner@acmecloud.com>, Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood security artifacts and short checklist

Bob / Alice,

Thanks for the quick reply. I attached our SOC2 summary and a short security checklist we typically use for procurement reviews. Key items:
- SOC2 Type II report (summary + control mapping)
- Data residency & encryption details
- Audit logging & retention options
- Personnel access controls & background checks

If there are any specific controls your team needs mapped, send them over and I'll produce a one-page mapping to your control IDs.

For timeline planning in the MAP: Typical path we see at companies your size is ~2 weeks legal review (small redlines) + 1-2 weeks InfoSec review (if standard controls) + finance PO cycle 1-2 weeks. So total ~4-6 weeks from mutual action plan sign-off to PO issuance, assuming no major redlines.

Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary-2026.pdf

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Head of Security Solutions | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.inference

From: Bob Turner <bob.turner@acmecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
Cc: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecloud.com>, Sarah Kim <legal@acmecloud.com>, Priya Shah <finance@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood security artifacts and short checklist

Marcus, thanks, this looks good. A few quick asks:
1) Can you confirm retention window for request/response logs and whether we can set a project-level retention policy?
2) Do you support customer-managed keys (CMK) via KMS/HSM for data at rest?
3) We'll need a short runbook for incident response and contacts for SOC escalation.

Timeline: assuming we get the SOC2 summary and a one-page control mapping, InfoSec will likely take 7-10 business days.

We are interested in AWS Marketplace for the demo/pilot to expedite procurement. Priya, Sarah — looping you for visibility.

-Bob
Director, InfoSec | AcmeCloud

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmecloud.com>, Bob Turner <bob.turner@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & procurement next steps (AcmeCloud)

Perfect — thanks everyone. Next actions I'll take today:
- Finalize and send the mutual action plan (attached) with milestones and target dates.
- Confirm marketplace options and provide an expedited AWS Marketplace path doc.
- Marissa will follow up on pricing for a 30-day card pilot vs 12-month Dedicated commitment (PO).

Could you please confirm the names/emails for Sarah and Priya so I can include them on the MAP and DocuSign flow? If we keep the pilot on-card we can start within days; if you want a PO for Dedicated we should plan the 4-6 week timeline Marcus outlined.

Best,
Rachel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
